pages.title: Illusory Feast
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r III$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r Swords, axes, tridents, bows, crossbows$(br2)§lEffect:§r Hitting a creature restores hunger and saturation (level I: 1/0.5, level II: 2/1.0, level III: 3/1.5), with a 0.5 second cooldown.$(br2)§lConflicts:§r None$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Enchanting table, loot chests, villager trades
